hunks.baseline: Whenever a System message like this appeared, I felt like I had become some kind of hero. An achievement, huh? That was quite an impressive way to package joining a Guild just to make money.
hunks.sol: Whenever a System message like this appeared, I felt like some kind of hero. An achievement, huh? That was a pretty grand way to describe joining a Guild for the money.

hunks.baseline: Ten points was a pretty sweet reward on its own, but after hearing what Team Leader Choi said next, I had to keep forcing down the corners of my mouth, which kept trying to shoot upward.
hunks.sol: Ten points was already a nice reward, but after hearing what Team Leader Choi said next, I had to keep fighting the grin that threatened to spread across my face.

hunks.baseline: “The signing bonus will be processed by the end of today. As for your housing and any other matters…”
hunks.sol: “The signing bonus will be processed by the end of today. As for your housing and other matters…”

hunks.baseline: A house and a car provided by the Guild, along with dozens of other benefits.
hunks.sol: A house and car provided by the Guild, along with dozens of other benefits.

hunks.baseline: I had already checked everything in the contract several times, but hearing it laid out like this still made it feel new.
hunks.sol: I had already gone over everything in the contract several times, but hearing it laid out like this made it all feel new again.

hunks.baseline: Until barely three months ago, I couldn’t have imagined my life turning out like this.
hunks.sol: Barely three months ago, I couldn’t have imagined my life turning out like this.

hunks.baseline: “As for equipment rentals, you can use anything you want apart from my collection… Huh?”
hunks.sol: “As for equipment rentals, you can use anything you want apart from my collection… Yes?”

hunks.baseline: “Could you slap me once? If this is a dream, I’d like to wake up quickly.”
hunks.sol: “Could you slap me? If this is a dream, I’d like to wake up.”

hunks.baseline: Thwack!
hunks.sol: Wham!

hunks.baseline: I rubbed my stinging jaw and muttered, “You really don’t hold back.”
hunks.sol: I rubbed my stinging jaw and muttered, “You really didn’t hold back.”

hunks.baseline: “You didn’t tell me not to use it, either.”
hunks.sol: “You didn’t tell me not to, either.”

hunks.baseline: Without the newly acquired **Toughness** stat, I might have gone sprawling in a most undignified fashion.
hunks.sol: Without my newly acquired **Toughness** stat, I might have gone sprawling in a most undignified fashion.

hunks.baseline: The fist he had thrown without even taking a stance had landed squarely on my jaw. The power and the point of impact had both been perfect.
hunks.sol: The punch he had thrown without even taking a stance had landed squarely on my jaw. The power, the point of impact—both perfect.

hunks.baseline: “Still, don’t people usually use a slap?”
hunks.sol: “Still, don’t people usually slap you in this situation?”

hunks.baseline: “There are exceptions. So? Are you feeling more awake now?”
hunks.sol: “There are exceptions. So, are you feeling more awake now?”

hunks.baseline: “……Very much so.”
hunks.sol: “……Wide awake.”

hunks.baseline: “Good. It’s better for making a first impression if you meet them while you’re in your right mind.”
hunks.sol: “Good. It’s better to be in your right mind when making a first impression.”

hunks.baseline: I looked at Team Leader Choi, bewildered by his sudden remark.
hunks.sol: His out-of-nowhere remark made me look at him in confusion.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi continued with a smile.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi smiled.

hunks.baseline: The owner of that deep, dignified voice, the sort that belonged in a coffee commercial, was Butler Kim. Even in the sweltering summer, he was dressed in a suit and was expertly driving the limousine.
hunks.sol: That deep, dignified voice, the sort that belonged in a coffee commercial, belonged to Butler Kim. Even in the sweltering summer heat, he wore a suit as he expertly drove the limousine.

hunks.baseline: For some reason, I found it difficult to speak naturally in front of this man. Was it because of the image of a butler I had only ever seen in dramas?
hunks.sol: For some reason, I found it hard to speak naturally around this man. Was it because the only butlers I had ever seen were in dramas?

hunks.baseline: After thinking about it for a moment, I decided it was because of Butler Kim’s distinctive atmosphere. The unfamiliarity of riding in a limousine for the first time might have had something to do with it, too.
hunks.sol: After giving it some thought, I decided it was Butler Kim’s distinctive air. The unfamiliarity of riding in a limousine for the first time might have had something to do with it too.

hunks.baseline: The interior was spacious and stocked with all sorts of things. For example, the small refrigerator Team Leader Choi had just opened.
hunks.sol: The interior was spacious and stocked with all sorts of things, including the small refrigerator Team Leader Choi had just opened.

hunks.baseline: I happened to be thirsty.
hunks.sol: I was thirsty anyway.

hunks.baseline: The bottle of water Team Leader Choi handed me didn’t have even the most ordinary brand name on it.
hunks.sol: The bottle he handed me didn’t have so much as a brand name on it.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: He told me it had been brought in from somewhere in the Himalayas, and I clicked my tongue inwardly.
hunks.sol: When Team Leader Choi told me it had been brought in from somewhere in the Himalayas, I clicked my tongue inwardly.

hunks.baseline: *That must cost a ridiculous amount.*
hunks.sol: *That must’ve cost a ridiculous amount.*

hunks.baseline: What a fucking waste of money. Still, when I took a sip, it was refreshingly cold.
hunks.sol: Talk about blowing money. Still, when I took a sip, it was refreshingly cold.

hunks.baseline: ……So this was what all that fucking money was for. Well, this was how wealth got redistributed and the economy stayed active. Right.
hunks.sol: ……So this was why rich people blew their money. Well, this was how wealth got redistributed and the economy stayed active. Right.

hunks.baseline: The limousine came to a stop while I was wondering whether I could sneak a few bottles away.
hunks.sol: While I was wondering whether I should pocket a few bottles, the limousine came to a stop.

hunks.baseline: The moment I got out of the car, my jaw dropped at the sight before me.
hunks.sol: The moment I stepped out, my jaw dropped at the sight before me.

hunks.baseline: A skyscraper towered into the sky. Its exterior gleamed even without direct sunlight, as if it had undergone some kind of magical treatment, and guards in formal uniforms stood waiting at the entrance.
hunks.sol: A skyscraper towered overhead. Its exterior gleamed even without direct sunlight, as if it had been treated with magic, and guards in formal uniforms stood at the entrance.

hunks.baseline: As I continued to marvel at the sight, Team Leader Choi approached me.
hunks.sol: As I continued gawking, Team Leader Choi came up beside me.

hunks.baseline: “Impressive, isn’t it? It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that all the branches of Korea’s top one hundred Guilds are gathered here. There are even branches of foreign mega-Guilds whose names you know just from hearing them.”
hunks.sol: “Impressive, isn’t it? It wouldn’t be an exaggeration to say that all of Korea’s top one hundred Guilds have branches here. There are even branches of major foreign Guilds whose names you’d recognize.”

hunks.baseline: “Neither of us lived through that era, but…… from what I understand, this would be more than that, if anything.”
hunks.sol: “Neither of us lived through that era, but…… from what I understand, this place is at least as expensive, if not more so.”

hunks.baseline: The value of land had been turned upside down long ago.
hunks.sol: The value of land had been turned on its head long ago.

hunks.baseline: Though it had happened before I was born, middle-aged Hunters who had lived through the pre-Great Cataclysm era sometimes became nostalgic and went on about what things had been like back then.
hunks.sol: Though it had happened before I was born, middle-aged Hunters who had lived before the Great Cataclysm sometimes grew nostalgic and reminisced about those days.

hunks.baseline: I knew what happened after that. In the early days of the Great Cataclysm, well-developed metropolitan areas and densely populated regions were the first targets of the monster armies, and humanity had been helpless against them.
hunks.sol: I knew what had happened after that. In the early days of the Great Cataclysm, developed cities and densely populated areas became the monster armies’ first targets, and humanity was helpless against them.

hunks.baseline: Present-day Gangnam and Bundang were cities that had already been destroyed once and rebuilt. After the Great Cataclysm, true prime real estate was divided into two types.
hunks.sol: Present-day Gangnam and Bundang had both been destroyed once and rebuilt. After the Great Cataclysm, true prime real estate fell into two categories.

hunks.baseline: Safe zones, where the chance of a Gate appearing was close to zero, were the best places for ordinary people to live. Gate-dense areas, meanwhile, had the ideal conditions for Hunter Guilds to establish themselves.
hunks.sol: Safe zones, where the chance of a Gate appearing was close to zero, were the best places for ordinary people to live. Gate-dense areas, meanwhile, offered ideal conditions for Hunter Guilds to establish themselves.

hunks.baseline: There were around a hundred Gates in Bucheon. Many of them were low-level Gates, but by sheer number, it was still one of the ten most densely concentrated regions in all of Korea.
hunks.sol: There were around a hundred Gates in Bucheon. Many were low-level, but by sheer number, Bucheon still ranked among the ten most Gate-dense areas in all of Korea.

hunks.baseline: I could tell just by looking at the skyscrapers packed around us. This was a neighborhood where your average small or mid-sized Guild couldn’t even set foot.
hunks.sol: One look at the skyscrapers surrounding us made it obvious. This was a neighborhood where your average small or mid-sized Guild couldn’t even set foot.

hunks.baseline: *What kind of money did this guy have?*
hunks.sol: *Just how rich is this guy?*

hunks.baseline: Just as I was looking at Team Leader Choi with awe, he spoke.
hunks.sol: I was staring at Team Leader Choi in awe when he spoke.

hunks.baseline: “Let’s work hard and move somewhere like that, too.”
hunks.sol: “Let’s work hard and move somewhere like that too.”

hunks.baseline: “I’ll devote my loyalty to you…… Huh?”
hunks.sol: “I pledge you my loyal— Huh?”

hunks.baseline: *Damn it, why do you think? Are you asking because you don’t know?*
hunks.sol: *Damn it, why do you think? Do you really have to ask?*

hunks.baseline: “You said we’d arrived?”
hunks.sol: “You said we’d arrived.”

hunks.baseline: I abruptly turned toward Butler Kim.
hunks.sol: I whipped my head toward Butler Kim.

hunks.baseline: “Yes. If you turn your head a little to the right from where you’re standing, you should see it.”
hunks.sol: “Yes. If you turn your head a little to the right, you should see it.”

hunks.baseline: I turned my head as he instructed. After a brief silence, I spoke.
hunks.sol: I turned as instructed. After a brief silence, I asked, “What is that run-down building?”

hunks.baseline: “What is that run-down building?”
Amid the luxurious skyscrapers, the building standing there all by itself looked especially small and dilapidated.
hunks.sol: Standing alone amid the luxurious skyscrapers, it looked especially small and dilapidated.

hunks.baseline: I narrowed my eyes and glared at the collapsing store. The yellowed sign read:
hunks.sol: I narrowed my eyes at the crumbling store. Its yellowed sign read:

hunks.baseline: “She was an old woman who had lived here for seventy years.”
hunks.sol: “She was an old woman who lived here for seventy years.”

hunks.baseline: “Now that I think about it, it’s quite elegant. Sounds like a name that promises a long life.”
hunks.sol: “Now that I think about it, it’s quite elegant. She sounds like someone who’d live to a ripe old age.”

hunks.baseline: “She was incredibly stubborn, so during the redevelopment of the Gate-dense area, she refused no matter how much money they offered. By then, the other Guilds had already established themselves… In the end, we purchased the property from her surviving family.”
hunks.sol: “She was incredibly stubborn. During the redevelopment of the Gate-dense area, she refused to sell no matter how much money they offered. By the time she passed, the other Guilds had already established themselves… In the end, we purchased the property from her surviving family.”

hunks.baseline: A Guild house was the face of a Guild. Its signboard. No matter how expensive the land in this neighborhood was, they had really chosen a place like that……
hunks.sol: A Guild house was the face of the Guild. Its signboard. No matter how expensive the land around here was, they had really chosen a place like that……

hunks.baseline: It was only that my expectations had been too high. In an industry crawling with scams, Team Leader Choi had shown me enough sincerity that I could trust him and follow his lead.
hunks.sol: My expectations had simply been too high. In an industry crawling with scams, Team Leader Choi had already shown me enough sincerity to earn my trust.

hunks.baseline: I grabbed Team Leader Choi’s hand.
hunks.sol: I grabbed his hand.

terminology_alerts.message: preferred glossary term appears in BASE but not SOL for this hunk

hunks.baseline: “I’ll really work hard. I don’t care whether our Guild house is Sooni’s Super or Sooni’s Building.”
hunks.sol: “I’ll work really hard. I don’t care whether our Guild house is Sooni’s Super or Sooni’s Building.”

hunks.baseline: “You know what they say. Though the beginning is humble, its end will be magnificent!”
hunks.sol: “You know what they say. Though the beginning may be humble, the end will be magnificent!”

hunks.baseline: “It’s already magnificent. Butler Kim, how much did it cost to purchase that lot?”
hunks.sol: “It’s already fairly magnificent. Butler Kim, how much did it cost to purchase that lot?”

hunks.baseline: Butler Kim answered.
“A little over two billion won per pyeong.[^1]”
hunks.sol: Butler Kim answered, “A little over two billion won per pyeong.[^1]”

hunks.baseline: “I believe the beginning is magnificent, but the end will be even more magnificent.”
hunks.sol: “I believe the beginning is magnificent, and the end will be even more magnificent.”

hunks.baseline: The gazes of Team Leader Choi and Butler Kim struck me like arrows. Just as they stared at me with expressions that seemed to ask, *What kind of asshole is this?* a sound rang out.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi and Butler Kim’s gazes pierced me like arrows. Just as they stared at me as if wondering, *What kind of asshole is this?* a sound rang out.

hunks.baseline: The sign, whose decades-old lettering had been neatly written in Hancom Batang, slammed into the ground.
hunks.sol: The decades-old sign, its lettering neatly printed in Hancom Batang, slammed into the ground.

hunks.baseline: Team Leader Choi muttered in a tiny voice. Then the door of the store opened, and someone stepped out.
hunks.sol: Team Leader Choi muttered in a tiny voice. Then the store door opened, and someone stepped out.

hunks.baseline: The powerful man grumbled as he lifted the fallen sign with one hand. At the appearance of this completely unexpected person, my mouth fell open.
hunks.sol: Grumbling, the monstrously strong man lifted the fallen sign with one hand. At the appearance of this completely unexpected person, my mouth fell open.

hunks.baseline: The good-natured middle-aged E-rank Hunter, Im Kkeokjeong, spotted us and waved with a bright smile.
hunks.sol: The good-natured, middle-aged E-rank Hunter Im Kkeokjeong spotted us and waved with a bright smile.

hunks.baseline: While I stood there dumbfounded, Im Kkeokjeong approached and patted me on the shoulder.
hunks.sol: As I stood there dumbfounded, Im Kkeokjeong approached and patted me on the shoulder.

hunks.baseline: “You little punk. Been doing well? I heard you became C-rank.”
hunks.sol: “You little punk. Been doing well? I heard you made C-rank.”

hunks.baseline: “I was stuck lying in the hospital when Team Leader Choi suddenly came to see me and asked if I wanted to join the Guild. I said yes without a second thought.”
hunks.sol: “I was stuck in the hospital when Team Leader Choi suddenly came to see me and asked if I wanted to join the Guild. I said yes without a second thought.”

hunks.baseline: “That young man knows what loyalty means. Mr. Kim over there doesn’t say much, but he’s a really good man. And Miss Song goes without saying.”
hunks.sol: “That young man knows what loyalty means. Mr. Kim over there doesn’t say much, but he’s a good man too. And Miss Song goes without saying.”

hunks.baseline: “No, wait. Just a second.”
hunks.sol: “No, wait. Hold on.”

hunks.baseline: What was going on here?
hunks.sol: What the hell was going on?

hunks.baseline: I asked as calmly as I could, “You joined recently?”
hunks.sol: I asked as calmly as I could, “So you only joined recently?”

hunks.baseline: “I heard that part. What about the others?”
hunks.sol: “I heard that part already. What about the others?”

hunks.baseline: “Where are the other Guild members? Surely these four aren’t all of us?”
hunks.sol: “Where are the other Guild members? Surely these four aren’t everyone.”

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong answered firmly, then added, “Miss Song went shopping. She said she’d throw you a welcome party.”
hunks.sol: Im Kkeokjeong answered firmly, then added, “Miss Song went grocery shopping. She said she’d throw you a welcome party.”

hunks.baseline: “Miss Song? She’s the last one?”
hunks.sol: “Miss Song? Don’t tell me she’s the last one.”

hunks.baseline: I couldn’t hear anything that came after that.
hunks.sol: I couldn’t hear anything after that.

hunks.baseline: *There are five of us.*
hunks.sol: *Five people.*

hunks.baseline: Im Kkeokjeong’s booming voice snapped me out of my daze as I stared at the collapsing Sooni’s Super.
hunks.sol: I stared blankly at the crumbling Sooni’s Super until Im Kkeokjeong’s booming voice snapped me out of my daze.

hunks.baseline: “Oh, there she is. Miss Song! Over here, over here! The newbie’s here!”
hunks.sol: “Oh, there she is. Miss Song! Over here! The new member’s here!”

hunks.baseline: I followed Im Kkeokjeong’s gaze and turned my head.
hunks.sol: I followed his gaze and turned my head.

hunks.sol: The final member of the tiny Guild—and one of its founding members.
